Package dev.shvquu.betternpcs.api.npc

Klasse NpcSnapshot.Builder

java.lang.Object
dev.shvquu.betternpcs.api.npc.NpcSnapshot.Builder
Umschließende Klasse:
NpcSnapshot
public static final class NpcSnapshot.Builder extends Object
Builds NpcSnapshot instances.

Not thread safe; build on one thread and share the immutable result.

1.0.0
